item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 10:42 PM, 21 November 2026(Saturday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bataan (Morong), Batangas (Cuenca, Alitagtag, San Jose, Lipa, Mataasnakahoy, and Santa Teresita), Bulacan (Norzagaray), Quezon (Jomalig, Polillo, Panukulan, Perez, Calauag, Quezon, Alabat, General Nakar, and Mauban), Rizal (Rodriguez), and Zambales (San Antonio, Subic, and Olongapo) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Quezon (Patnanungan and Burdeos) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
